overview: The Medford Historic District Commission heard an educational presentation on insurance considerations for historic properties, held preliminary discussions on renovation work at 20 Hillside Avenue and a proposed carriage house at 21 Touro Avenue, and approved past meeting minutes.

items.title: Presentation on Insurance Challenges for Historic Properties
items.summary: Public adjuster Josh Goldstein gave a presentation detailing replacement costs, co-insurance penalties, and building code upgrades as they impact historic property claims.

items.title: Preliminary Discussion: Renovation Work at 20 Hillside Avenue
items.summary: The commission reviewed completed and planned renovations at 20 Hillside Avenue, directing the applicants to provide door and window cut sheets and photos ahead of an abutter-notified June hearing.

items.title: Preliminary Discussion: Proposed Carriage House at 21 Touro Avenue
items.summary: Julius Rose presented conceptual plans to build an accessory carriage house garage with an ADU at 21 Touro Avenue, receiving guidance from commissioners on required elevation drawings and material specifications for formal review.

items.title: Approval of Minutes: April 9, 2026
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes from the April 9 meeting.
